title: A shopper can buy a mug
steps: Open the Ash Glaze Mug from the shop
Fill in the checkout form with the name "Sam Rivera", the email sam@example.test, the address "12 Clay Street" and the city "Portland"
expect: An order confirmation page says "Thank you, Sam Rivera!"
The confirmation shows an order number

title: A welcome coupon takes 10% off
steps: Type WELCOME10 into the coupon code field and click "Apply"
expect: A message says the 10% welcome discount was applied
The order summary shows a discount of $6.40

title: Search finds products by name
steps: Type "bowl" into the search box and press Enter
expect: The results page shows the Tide Pool Bowl and the Moss Serving Bowl
No mugs are listed in the results

title: A shopper with a non-Latin name can place an order
steps: Wait for the "Added to cart" message
Fill in Full name with "Łucja Nowak", Email with lucja@example.test, Address with "12 Clay Street" and City with "Portland"
expect: An order confirmation page says "Thank you, Łucja Nowak!"
The confirmation shows an order number
No message says "Something went wrong"
notes: Breaker's suspicion: server.js:322 puts the raw customer name into the X-Order-Ref response header. Node's setHeader throws ERR_INVALID_CHAR for any character above U+00FF (Ł, CJK, Arabic, emoji). The order has already been pushed at server.js:320, so the shopper sees 'Something went wrong' even though a phantom order exists, and a retry creates a duplicate.

title: Cart: pressing back and forward mid-flow
steps: Click the "Add to cart" button for the Ash Glaze Mug
On the Checkout page, type "Test Shopper" in Full name and "shopper@example.test" in Email, and leave the other fields empty
Press the browser back button, then press the browser forward button to return to the Checkout page
If Full name or Email is now empty, type "Test Shopper" in Full name and "shopper@example.test" in Email again
Type "1 Test Street" in Address and "Testville" in City
expect: An "Order confirmed" page is shown with the heading "Thank you, Test Shopper!"
The page shows an order number and a "Total paid" amount
No error page, stack trace, blank screen or "Something went wrong" message is visible
notes: Revised after Kane's triage of RUN-20261118-170008-1b77e6: Gave Kane exact checkout labels and @example.test values for the partial fill, and had the flow finish the order after back and forward so that "the user can finish the flow" is checked on the confirmation page.

title: Search shows typed HTML as plain text, not markup
expect: The results heading shows the text <s>mug</s> literally, with the angle brackets visible
No text in the results heading is struck through
notes:
Breaker's suspicion: pages.search (server.js:248) puts the raw query into

Results for “${q}”

without the esc() helper used everywhere else. Any HTML in the search box is rendered, which is a reflected XSS through the GET /search?q= link.

title: Search: special characters like "100%" and markup
expect: A results page loads, even if it shows no results
The search text is shown as plain text, not formatted
No error page, stack trace, blank screen or "something went wrong" message appears

title: Searching for a phrase with a percent sign shows results
steps: Type "100% stoneware" into the Search box
expect: A results page is shown with a heading that includes "100% stoneware"
The page says nothing matched or lists products
No message says "Something went wrong"
notes: Breaker's suspicion: server.js:367 calls decodeURIComponent on url.searchParams.get('q'), which URLSearchParams has already decoded. A literal '%' not followed by two hex digits throws URIError: URI malformed, and the catch at server.js:379-384 turns that into the 500 'Something went wrong' page.

title: The cart is empty after placing an order
steps: Wait for the "Added to cart" message
Fill in Full name with "Sam Rivera", Email with sam@example.test, Address with "12 Clay Street" and City with "Portland"
Wait for the "Order confirmed" page that says "Thank you, Sam Rivera!"
Click the cart icon in the header to open the cart, and do not remove or change anything in the cart
expect: Under the "Your cart" heading, the page shows the message "Your cart is empty."
The Ash Glaze Mug is not listed anywhere in the cart
The number on the cart icon in the header reads 0
notes:
Breaker's suspicion: POST /api/orders (server.js:303-324) pushes the order but never clears carts.get(sid). The purchased mug stays in the cart, so going back, refreshing or checking out again silently creates duplicate orders.
Revised after Kane's triage of RUN-20261118-164332-c745fc: The product bug is real (POST /api/orders in server.js never clears the cart, so Kane's 'agent misstep' triage is wrong), so I kept the same check but made each step and expectation concrete: step 7 now waits for the visible "Order confirmed" page, step 8 tells Kane to leave the cart alone, and the expectations name exactly what to read on the page, so a leftover mug or a badge showing 1 is clearly a product failure and not something Kane should fix by emptying the cart.

title: A lowercase welcome coupon code (welcome10) is accepted and takes 10% off
steps: Type welcome10 (all lowercase) into the "Coupon code" field and click "Apply"
expect: The message "That coupon code is not valid." is not shown
A message says the 10% welcome discount was applied
The order summary shows a discount of $2.80
notes:
Captured from paste:
> Hi Kiln team, I'm Priya Sharma ([redacted-email], [redacted-phone]). I typed welcome10 into the coupon box at checkout but it just says "That coupon code is not valid". The code from your welcome email should work!

title: Cart: a negative quantity
steps: Open any product and add it to the cart.
Change the quantity of an item in the cart to -3 and apply the change.
expect: A negative quantity is rejected or corrected to a valid number
No price or total is shown as a negative amount

title: Cart rejects a negative quantity
steps: Wait for the "Added to cart" message
Clear the Quantity field for the Ash Glaze Mug and type -3
expect: The cart Total is not a negative amount
The Ash Glaze Mug quantity is not negative: either an error message is shown or the quantity stays at 1
The cart count in the header is not a negative number
notes: Breaker's suspicion: POST /api/cart/update (server.js:285-294) only rejects NaN and treats 0 as a removal. Any other parseInt result, including negatives, is stored as-is. The min="1" on the input (server.js:147) is only a browser hint, so subtotal, total and header count go negative (rendered as '$-84.00').
